response.sql: WITH spatial_with_projects AS (SELECT sp.*, p.fundflux FROM scanspatial sp JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry), fundflux_counts AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as count FROM spatial_with_projects GROUP BY fundflux), total_and_avg AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, AVG(count) as avg_count FROM fundflux_counts) SELECT fc.fundflux, fc.count, fc.count * 100.0 / ta.total_count as share, fc.count - ta.avg_count as above_average FROM fundflux_counts fc CROSS JOIN total_and_avg ta WHERE fc.count > ta.avg_count
